definitions.explanation: A pricing or billing system where charges are based on the amount actually used or consumed, rather than a flat rate. Applied to utilities, data plans, shipping, and various services.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}{料金|りょうきん}は{従量制|じゅうりょうせい}だ。
このプランは{従量制|じゅうりょうせい}なので、{使|つか}った{分|ぶん}だけ{払|はら}えばいい。
examples.english: This plan is pay-per-use, so you only pay for what you use.

examples.japanese: {定額制|ていがくせい}と{従量制|じゅうりょうせい}のどちらが{自分|じぶん}に{合|あ}っているか、{毎月|まいつき}の{使用量|しようりょう}を{確認|かくにん}してから{決|き}めたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should check your monthly usage before deciding whether a flat-rate or usage-based plan suits you better.

notes:
Composed of {従量|じゅうりょう} (according to quantity) and {制|せい} (system). The word {従量|じゅうりょう} literally means "following the amount" — charges scale with consumption.

This is an important practical term for living in Japan: utilities (water, gas, electricity), mobile phone plans, cloud computing services, and shipping all commonly use either {従量制|じゅうりょうせい} (usage-based) or {定額制|ていがくせい} (flat-rate) pricing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {従量制|じゅうりょうせい}{料金|りょうきん}: usage-based charges
- {従量制|じゅうりょうせい}プラン: pay-per-use plan
- {従量|じゅうりょう}{課金|かきん}: metered billing
- {従量制|じゅうりょうせい}と{定額制|ていがくせい}: usage-based vs. flat-rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定額制|ていがくせい}: flat-rate system — the opposite model, where a fixed fee covers unlimited use
- {定額|ていがく}: fixed amount; flat rate — the base term
- サブスクリプション: subscription — flat-rate access model, loanword from English
